name: @operon/gatekeeper-chronicle
description: The chronicle Gatekeeper: the colony's introspection surface. Receives wake transcript chunks from containers (tailable live from a per-wake Durable Object, mirrored durably to the central D1), and serves the operator's read API over the audit database: events, messages, wakes, transcripts. Operator-authenticated reads; the container's append door is internal-bearer only.
